title: Eleven Parts and One Machine
subtitle: 部件与构成 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 部件与构成（科学与技术·结构与部件）
meta: 主题语境：部件与构成（科学与技术·结构与部件）　|　核心词汇：component　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 component 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my uncle ① listed every component of a machine that had never worked, and he said the listing was the whole of the repair. The ② component, meaning the part and not the whole, was the eleventh and the smallest; component, he said, is the only thing in a machine that is judged by how easily it is overlooked.

Every ③ component on that bench had the same number stamped on it, and the ④ component at the end, meaning the one he kept for last and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever ordered twice. Component, my aunt said, is nine parts ordering and one part somebody willing to wait; my uncle said the waiting is the part that fills the bench.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the component was the whole of the course, meaning the unit and not the metal. The ⑥ component, meaning the unit and not any of that, is the only thing in a course that everybody must pass and nobody enjoys; component, she said, is either something you list or the only word that means both a part and a unit. He said the unit is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ component had become a line in an order form, and the form had become an argument about the number. The ⑧ component of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in May, was one machine and thirty years of listing; component, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to wait. She said the waiting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ component I remember is the one at the end, which was ordered in 1980 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ component, my aunt said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being fitted; every component, she said, is a unit that has agreed to look like a part. She said the unit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 部件（指那一个零件本身，与那整台机器相对）
C. 固定搭配：list every component of 列出……的每一个部件
D. n. 部件（指那张工作台上每一个）
E. n. 部件（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 组成部分；单元（指课程的组成单元）
G. n. 部件（指订单表里提到的那一个）
H. n. 构成要素（抽象总称）

answers.why: list every component of 意为“列出……的每一个部件”，1966 年叔叔列出了一台从未运转过的机器的每一个部件。
component 意为“部件”，指那一个零件本身而不是那整台机器，它是第十一个，也是最小的。
component 指那张工作台上每一个部件，每一个都印着同样的编号。
component 指末尾那一个（他留到最后装的那一个），是唯一有人订购过两次的。
component 意为“组成部分、单元”，母亲说这个单元就是那门课的全部，指的是那个教学单元而不是那块金属。
component 为抽象用法，指课程的组成单元而不是那块金属，是课程里人人都得过、却无人喜欢的东西。
component 意为“部件”，指订单表里提到的那一个，到 1974 年这个部件成了订单表上的一行。
component 意为“构成要素”，叔叔五月写道，整件事的构成要素是一台机器三十年的列清单。
component 意为“部件、零件”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1980 年订购，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
component 为抽象总称，姑姑说一个部件是唯一会因为被装上而变好的东西。
